text: If the zombie apocalypse started today... you'd have five days to get it right.
Day one. Everyone panics. Which means the supermarket is now... a war zone.
Skip the toilet paper. Grab water, cans, and batteries.
Day two. You don't know who's infected yet. So treat everyone like they are.
Hiii! It's Gary. From 4B. Can I borrow some... sugar?
Day three. The animals turn too. Rats. Pigeons. And yes...
Day four. Move higher. One way in, no ground floor windows, and a door you can lock.
Day five. Something bit you. And your entire first aid kit is... one unicorn band-aid.
Rule number one: don't let the others find out.
Hey! Are you okay in there?
